knowledge_gaps: The baseline → objective-only → fused sequence does not isolate the recent branch’s effect from the added LayerNorm and parameters. Include a normalization-matched control and simple ungated recent pooling. The proposed gate is context-dependent, not candidate-dependent, so compatibility claims remain unsupported.

The sampled-softmax objective needs its own justification: gSASRec establishes generalized BCE, not this loss. Sampling with or without replacement, duplicate handling, temperature, masking, and loss reduction remain unspecified.

Reproduction requires gate dimensions and initialization, padding-aware causal pooling, optimizer settings, checkpoint selection, and an explicit GPU-time allocation. Chunking logits alone does not necessarily bound backward-pass memory.

There are no measured validation gains or uncertainty estimates. With 200 users per category, repeated checkpoint and configuration selection can overfit validation. Originality 4 is plausible, but potential 8 and difficulty 4 are provisional judgments.
